create.name: Two Rivers Zen Community
create.bio:
Two Rivers Zen Community is a Soto Zen sangha that now meets entirely online, with its roots in Hawley, in north-eastern Pennsylvania. It was co-founded by Seiso Paul Cooper Roshi and a group of his students, among them Myoki Marcia Nehemiah, who began practising with him in 2011, received lay entrustment in 2020 and has been the community's guiding teacher since 2023. Lay practice leaders help run sittings and classes, and the community traces its practice back to Dogen and the Japanese Soto school.

The Zoom zendo is open every morning of the week for a short period of zazen, with a longer Sunday sitting and service. On Wednesday evenings a sitting is followed by text study that rotates through the month, from Robert Aitken's Zen Master Raven to the Heart Sutra and Dogen's essay on being-time. Each month brings a full-moon bodhisattva precepts ceremony and a half-day silent sit, and the year includes full-day zazenkai, a Rohatsu day in December and seasonal ango practice periods. Newcomers are offered a short one-to-one orientation, and practitioners can meet the teacher privately for dokusan. Support is by dana rather than fees.

courses.title: Winter Ango
courses.description: A three-month online practice period in which participants take on extra zazen, study and work practice to deepen their commitment, running from early December to the end of February.

courses.title: Full-Day Rohatsu
courses.description: A day of online zazenkai honouring the Buddha's awakening, with silent sitting, walking meditation, ceremony and time together as a sangha.

courses.title: Wednesday Evening Dharma
courses.description: Half an hour of zazen on Zoom followed by a class on a Zen text, with a different text and facilitator each week of the month, from Aitken's Zen Master Raven to the Heart Sutra and Dogen's Uji.

free_resources.title: Zooming Zazen
free_resources.description: The daily online sitting schedule with Zoom links and simple etiquette for practising together on screen, including the monthly extended Sunday sit.

free_resources.title: The Bodhisattva Precepts
free_resources.description: The full text of the sixteen bodhisattva precepts as the community recites them: the refuges, the three pure precepts and the ten grave precepts with their commentary.
